meta.legal_basis: Republic Act No. 11313 (Safe Spaces Act) and its IRR — gender-based online sexual harassment research mapping
meta.disclaimer: Weights and thresholds are draft operationalizations for research. They must be finalized with a legal expert's validated definitions. HARAYA does not issue legal findings.

electronic_communication.label: Electronic communication
electronic_communication.description: The conduct occurred through electronic or online messaging.

physical_harm.label: Physical harm
physical_harm.description: The speaker expresses intent or a threat to cause bodily injury.

sexual_context.label: Sexual context
sexual_context.description: The conversation contains sexual remarks, requests, or sexualized commentary.

gender_based_targeting.label: Gender-based targeting
gender_based_targeting.description: The conduct targets a person because of sex, gender, gender identity, or sexual orientation.

misogynistic_language.label: Misogynistic language
misogynistic_language.description: Language that demeans, degrades, or expresses hatred toward women.

sexist_language.label: Sexist language
sexist_language.description: Language that assigns inferior roles or abilities on the basis of sex.

homophobic_language.label: Homophobic language
homophobic_language.description: Language that demeans or attacks a person because of same-sex attraction or gay identity.

transphobic_language.label: Transphobic language
transphobic_language.description: Language that denies, mocks, or attacks a person's gender identity.

repeated_communication.label: Repeated communication
repeated_communication.description: Multiple unsolicited messages are sent across the conversation.

continued_after_refusal.label: Continued contact after refusal
continued_after_refusal.description: Contact continues after the other person asked to stop, refused, or blocked.

monitoring_or_pursuit.label: Monitoring or pursuit
monitoring_or_pursuit.description: The speaker watches, follows, tracks, or otherwise monitors the other person.

multiple_accounts.label: Multiple accounts
multiple_accounts.description: The speaker indicates they will use another account or identity to keep contacting the person.

intimidation.label: Intimidation
intimidation.description: The speaker uses threats, pressure, or coercive language to control or frighten the other person.

fear_or_coercion.label: Fear or coercion
fear_or_coercion.description: The interaction creates fear, distress, or coerced compliance.

actual_disclosure.label: Actual disclosure of private information
actual_disclosure.description: Private personal information is shared or posted without consent.

threatened_disclosure.label: Threatened disclosure of private information
threatened_disclosure.description: The speaker threatens to share private personal information without consent.

unwanted_contact.label: Unwanted contact
unwanted_contact.description: Messages are sent despite lack of consent or after a request to stop.

Non-Harassment.legal_reference: No gender-based online sexual harassment elements established under RA 11313 for this conversation.

Physical Threat.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment involving threats of physical harm.

Psychological / Emotional Threat.legal_reference: RA 11313 — online conduct causing fear, humiliation, or psychological distress.

Unwanted Sexual Remarks/Comments.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment, including unwanted sexual remarks.

Misogynistic Remarks/Comments.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment involving misogynistic remarks.

Sexist Remarks/Comments.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment involving sexist remarks.

Homophobic Remarks/Comments.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment involving homophobic remarks.

Transphobic Remarks/Comments.legal_reference: RA 11313 — gender-based online sexual harassment involving transphobic remarks.

Cyberstalking.legal_reference: RA 11313 Sec. 12 — online stalking, including unwanted pursuit and monitoring through electronic means.

Incessant Messaging.legal_reference: RA 11313 — unwanted and repeated electronic communications after lack of consent.

Unauthorized Sharing of Personal Informa.legal_reference: RA 11313 / related cybercrime mapping — non-consensual sharing or threatened sharing of private information.
